author: New China TV
description: A newly opened cardiac hospital on the outskirts of Kabul has begun offering specialized treatment for children living with congenital heart defects, restoring their ability to breathe freely, reclaiming their childhood smiles, and enabling them to envision a healthier tomorrow. #Kabul #Afghanistan
title: Kabul's new hospital brings life-saving surgery to Afghan children

author: New China TV
description: China's railways saw the peak of the holiday return rush on Wednesday, with 24.15 million passenger trips expected on the final day of the National Day holiday, amid strong travel demand and vibrant tourism activity across the country. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | China's railways see holiday return peak amid vibrant tourism market

author: New China TV
description: During China's #NationalDay holiday, a festive lakeside market at Dianchi Lake in Kunming, southwest China, comes alive with coffee, artisan baked food, and live music. It offers a relaxing, diverse taste of local cultural tourism. Join Xinhua's Xiong Xuan'ang to feel the market's lively holiday vibe. (recorded) #ChinaTravel #GoldenWeek
title: Coffee, cakes & music: Dianchi Lake's holiday market comes alive

author: New China TV
description:
Camels have their own traffic lights in Dunhuang! 
At the Mingsha Mountain and Crescent Spring scenic spot, camel teams move through an intersection in an orderly way under the guidance of specially designed traffic lights.
#Dunhuang #ChinaTravel #Camel #Gansu #NationalDay #TravelChina
title: Camel traffic lights? Only in Dunhuang!

author: New China TV
description: Built at about 1,400 meters above sea level in Yuexi County, east #China's #Anhui Province, the 250-meter-long walkway has 620 steps and a vertical drop of 365 meters. With the sheer drop beneath their feet, visitors grip the handrails and carefully make their way forward. #Travel #Adventure #Skywalk #Nature
title: Sky-high staircase with 365-m drop draws thrill-seeking visitors in China

author: New China TV
description: Medals, the torch, uniforms and equipment for the Changchun 2027 Winter Universiade were unveiled Wednesday at a 100-day countdown event at Changchun International Aviation Expo City. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Changchun 2027 Winter Universiade unveils medals, torch

author: New China TV
description: Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai have been awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis, the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announced Wednesday. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Henri Kagan, Kenso Soai win 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry

author: New China TV
description: A rare #waterspout was spotted swirling over the Xijiang River in south #China's #Guangdong Province. Authorities estimate the waterspout was about 60 meters in diameter. No damage was reported. If you spot one, keep your distance and stay away from riverside areas. #Weather #Nature
title: Rare 60-m waterspout spins up over river in China's Guangdong

author: New China TV
description: One more survivor of the Nanjing Massacre passed away on Wednesday, reducing the number of registered living survivors to 20, the Memorial Hall of the Victims in Nanjing Massacre by Japanese Invaders said. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Another Nanjing Massacre survivor dies, only 20 remain

author: New China TV
description: Small counties, big appeal: Visitors from home and abroad are venturing beyond China's big cities to discover local traditions and unique experiences in county-level destinations. #NationalDay #ChinaTravel
title: Small counties, big appeal: China's "golden week" fuels diverse getaways

author: New China TV
description: China's National Day holiday saw a vibrant wave of cultural and tourism activities across the country, with intangible cultural heritage adding festive cheer and enriching visitors' holiday experiences. #NationalDay #CulturalHeritage #ChinaTravel
title: Diverse cultural experiences drive China's National Day holiday tourism

author: New China TV
description: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded Tuesday to Francis Halzen "for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin." Why does detecting neutrinos matter in physics? A member of the Nobel Committee for Physics explained. #NobelPrize #neutrino
title: Nobel Committee member explains: Why detecting neutrinos matters in physics

author: New China TV
description: With just a few taps on a smartphone, automated drones deliver meals and drinks to smart lockers in minutes. Along Shanghai's West Bund, China's technological innovation is turning futuristic convenience into an everyday experience.
title: Drone delivery creates new consumer experiences in Shanghai

author: New China TV
description:
"Not only does China benefit, but ASEAN countries also get access to much cheaper goods because of this canal." 
A Cambodian media publisher has hailed China's newly opened Pinglu Canal as it will boost trade and logistics between China and ASEAN. #PingluCanal #Guangxi #China #ASEAN
title: Pinglu Canal to boost China-ASEAN trade, logistics: Cambodian media publisher

author: New China TV
description: During China's National Day holiday, a sea of clouds rolled over Mount Huashan in northwest China's Shaanxi Province, creating a breathtaking natural ink-wash painting. #MountHuashan #ChinaTravel #VisitChina #Nature
title: Sea of clouds rolls over Mount Huashan, China

author: New China TV
description: A walk through history with a high-tech boost. Wearable exoskeletons are making it easier for visitors to explore the centuries-old city wall in Xi'an, China. #ChinaTravel #ChinaTech #ExploreChina #Exoskeleton #Robotics
title: Chinese exoskeleton technology helps visitors explore Xi'an's ancient city wall

author: New China TV
description: A commemorative exhibition dedicated to Philippine WWII "comfort women" victims has opened in Manila. Between 1942 and 1945, approximately 1,000 Filipino women and girls were forced into sexual slavery as "comfort women." #GLOBALink #PhilippineWWIIcomfortwomen
title: Justice for "comfort women" -- Philippine exhibition calls for acknowledging wartime atrocities

author: New China TV
description: Kenya on Tuesday confirmed its first case of the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, in a patient who has since died, prompting the government to heighten vigilance amid an ongoing outbreak in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Kenya on high alert after confirming first case of Ebola
